fieldValues.title: A slice cannot be byte-reproducible because it records its export time
fieldValues.summary: slice.exportedAt is required, so two exports of the same container give different bytes and a different checksum, unlike srs archive pack, which is byte-identical by rule.
evidence: Two slice exports of the same state, 2026-11-27: different sha256
fieldValues.body: The carrier binding still works, because it covers the bytes embedded, but a rebuilt carrier cannot be checked against an earlier one by checksum. Options: make exportedAt optional, or define the slice's content checksum to exclude it.
